sloka: ा राघवो वाक्यं वायुपुत्रेण भाषितम् ।तमालोक्य माहतेजाः प्रदुद्राव स राघवः ।वैरोचनमिव क्रुद्धो विष्णुरभ्युद्यतायुधः ।। ६.५९.१२८ ।।।।
transliteration: ā rāghavo vākyaṁ vāyuputreṇa bhāṣitam ।tamālokya māhatejāḥ pradudrāva sa rāghavaḥ ।vairocanamiva kruddho viṣṇurabhyudyatāyudhaḥ ।। 6.59.128 ।।।।

translations.english: Beholding Ravana, highly energetic Rama wielding his bow went furiously towards him just as Lord Vishnu went with his discuss against Virochana.
